status_summary: Executive Order 14154 (signed 2025-01-20, published 2025-01-29) revoked Executive Orders 14008 and 14096, among others; the latter concerned environmental justice. Executive Orders 14151 and 14173 directed agencies to end DEI programs. E&E News reported on 2025-01-24 that DOE's acting Secretary told staff the department was suspending work requiring community benefit plans and Justice40 requirements. A DOE counsel memorandum dated 2025-02-28 allows removal of such terms from pending and future awards and, in light of a 2025-02-21 preliminary injunction, directs rescission of stop-work orders citing the DEI orders. The Office of Energy Justice and Equity had staff on leave by 2025-02-06, and the 2025-11-20 DOE organization chart shows no separate energy justice office.

timeline.event: DOE's acting Secretary told staff DOE was suspending work that requires or enforces community benefit plans and Justice40 requirements and moving to end DEI policies and funding.
In an email that day, DOE shared with OPM a list of 69 DEI-related employees placed on administrative leave, per E&E News reporting.
Executive Order 14154 published; section 4 revokes Executive Orders 14008 and 14096, among others.
Executive Order 14151, ending federal DEI programs and preferencing, published.
Executive Order 14173, on illegal discrimination and merit-based opportunity, published.
Senate Democrats urged the Energy Secretary not to terminate the Office of Energy Justice and Equity, which had staff on leave; the office was reported as at risk, not confirmed terminated.
DOE counsel memorandum, issued in light of a court order, permits removal of community benefit plan, DEI and Justice40 terms from pending and future funding actions.
DOE organization chart lists an Office of Minority Economic Impact and no separate energy justice office.
